_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
# Smart Cuff v3.1.367 - Default

Smart Const and High Max now calculate their PVR target on the Arduino within a 9.5-second computation budget, reserving reporting time below ten seconds. Accepted estimates use the cuff-envelope peak. Rejection or numerical timeout returns 80 mmHg; STOP or a protection fault aborts without refill.

The 0.5-5 Hz Butterworth filter, 5 dB SNR threshold, supported split-Gaussian peak, measured recovery and pressure bounds remain. Smart Const caps accepted 130-140 mmHg peaks at 130; High Max permits targets through 140. Radial MAP and bias correction are not inputs. Redundant fits, overlapping windows and raw predictions were reduced; final raw-screen changes preserve every retained historical replay decision and diagnostic.

The device and GUI show calculation stage, elapsed seconds and activity. RUN blinks 0.5 seconds on/0.5 seconds off per new 5 mmHg during inflation/deflation, merging overlapping triggers. PVR and waits blink at entry and every five seconds. The startup screen shows **v3.1.344 / 11/09/2026**.

## Physical simulator qualification

Device C, ProSim 8, firmware START runner shared by GUI and standalone operation. OLED mirroring was active. Each completed run applied the reported final target, refilled to it and finished safely.

| Protocol / simulator setting | PVR target (mmHg) | Calculation (s) | Estimate outcome | Control score |
|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| Smart Const, 120/80, 72 bpm | 99.42 | 7.638 | Accepted | PASS |
| High Max, 120/80, 30 bpm | 95.62 | 8.745 | Accepted | PASS |
| High Max, 165/100, 72 bpm | 80.00 | 7.746 | Rejected: raw disagreement | PASS |

Each run delivered **100%** of emitted sequence-numbered telemetry with no duplicates. Distinct OLED frames and one-second progress reports were retained. STOP during physical calculation reached safe idle in 0.125 seconds, with no refill after cancellation.

**Known failed peak-estimation case:** at 165/100 and 72 bpm, the filtered candidate was 123.04 mmHg (SNR 22.74 dB), but raw-envelope agreement rejected it. The device returned the requested 80 mmHg fallback in 7.746 seconds. This passed timing and control checks; it did not pass peak acceptance. The original failed acceptance-matrix result is retained. Further work is needed on this higher-pressure disagreement; this release does not claim successful estimates for every simulator setting.

## Ten-minute seed-213 soak

| Cycle | Preset | Measured deflation (mmHg/s) | Command ratio | Reversal score | Delivery |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| 1 | smart const | 3.62 | 0.91 | PASS | 100% |
| 2 | arm cvp | 0.91 | 0.91 | PASS | 100% |
| 3 | smart const | 3.60 | 0.90 | PASS | 100% |
| 4 | wrist cvp | 0.97 | 0.97 | PASS | 100% |
| 5 | regular | 3.60 | 0.90 | PASS | 100% |
| 6 | high max | 3.58 | 0.89 | PASS | 100% |

Soak delivery: **27337/27337 frames (100%)**, no flags. Non-CVP rates use the 150-40 mmHg band; CVP uses the whole descent. Calculation time is excluded from the scored descent. Soak PVR calculations: 6.279, 6.154, 7.316 seconds. The scored physical runs plus soak delivered **42287/42287 frames (100%)**.

## Software checks and limits

120 focused checks, all seven required GUI suites including layout/smoke, and the firmware compile passed (215376 bytes). Protected flash/readback preserved device C calibration, valve limits, feedforward and PID. Clean 72/50/30 bpm Due tests accepted in 6.075/4.736/4.985 seconds; the maximum peak error in those tests was 1.459 mmHg.

Historical replay accepted 2,643/3,024 intervals, versus 2,704 with firmware343: 13 newly accepted and 74 newly rejected. Among 2,630 paired accepted intervals, the median absolute peak difference was 0.30 mmHg; 61 differ by more than 5 and 13 by more than 10 mmHg. These compare algorithms, not arterial-reference accuracy. The 96-case artifact suite retains four known wrong acceptances at smooth pulse-rate interference. Simulator and replay tests do not establish clinical accuracy or guarantee maximum constant-hold amplitude for every measurement.

## Build and installation

Application **v3.1.367**; firmware wire identity **rev27v-followup-344**. Default source commit `1dc4c05b1deffbbcf0f1bfe69e6a204ef1173a60`. Built UTC `2026-11-09T22:25:15.8825995Z` from a clean tree; installer 224224515 bytes; SHA-256 `49520c50238d2d8f5aabb853a8178a70129d2cc3328481e799845d9d781fef60`.

The installer is unsigned. For a first manual installation, choose **More info -> Run anyway** if SmartScreen appears. Existing Default installations set to Latest use the verified automatic update path. This release supersedes unpublished versions 365/366; those installers were never promoted.
